---
title: "Issues"
engine: knitr
---

```{r}
#| results: asis
source("lidarbench_report.R")
lb_banner()
issues <- lb_table("issues")
```

Execution failures, skipped workloads, validation failures, unverified or not
validated outputs, missing measurements and monitoring gaps, one row per
occurrence (warm-ups and superseded retries included and marked). Included
measurements can also appear here (for example `unverified_output`).

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (is.null(issues) || !nrow(issues)) {
  cat("_No issues were recorded._\n\n")
} else {
  counts <- as.data.frame(table(kind = issues$kind), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(counts) <- c("kind", "count")
  lb_kable(counts)
  for (kind in sort(unique(issues$kind))) {
    cat("## ", kind, "\n\n", sep = "")
    lb_kable(issues[issues$kind == kind, , drop = FALSE],
             c("scope", "phase", "workload", "dataset", "cpus", "tool", "repetition",
               "attempt_id", "superseded", "detail"))
  }
}
lb_download("issues")
```
